tspan.tspan: 中按顺序执行的密钥生成语句

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
main.py 顶层入口
KeyGen、Sign、Verify 是阶段名，并非三个同名函数

div.style: color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
导入 parameters.py
k=l=4、N=256、q=8380417、eta=2
d=13、gamma1=131072、gamma2=95232、beta=78、omega=80

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
generate_key.generate_seed()
os.urandom(32) → xi

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
generate_key.derive_seeds(xi, k, l)
SHAKE256 派生 rho、rho_prime、K

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
generate_key.generate_key_A_NTT(rho, k, l)
内部调用 rej_ntt_poly → A_hat

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ntt_utils.inverse_ntt_A(A_hat)
内部调用 inverse_ntt_matrix → A
inverse_ntt_matrix 调用 bit_reverse_8；使用缓存

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
generate_key.generate_key_s(rho_prime, k, l, eta)
内部调用 rej_bounded_poly → s1、s2

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
generate_key.generate_key_t(A, s1, s2, k, l, N, q)
内部调用 multiplier → t = A·s1 + s2 mod q

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
generate_key.power2round(t, d=13)
得到 t1、t0

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
key_encode.pk_encode(rho, t1)
内部调用 bit_pack → pk

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
key_encode.generate_tr(pk)
SHAKE256 → tr

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
key_encode.sk_encode(rho, K, tr, s1, s2, t0)
内部调用 bit_pack 三次 → sk
当前 main.py 后续没有使用 sk

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: message = b'Hello Dilithium!'

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
sign.sign(message, A, s1, s2, t0, tr, K)
内部执行随机拒绝采样循环 → sig
直接传入密钥数组与种子，不解码 sk

div.style: color: rgb(88, 28, 135) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
result1 = verify.verify(message, pk, sig)
正确消息：预期 True

div.style: color: rgb(88, 28, 135) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
result2 = verify.verify(b'Hello Dilithium?', pk, sig)
篡改消息：预期 False

div.style: color: rgb(88, 28, 135) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
bad_sig = bytearray(sig)
bad_sig[0] ^= 1

div.style: color: rgb(88, 28, 135) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
result3 = verify.verify(message, pk, bytes(bad_sig))
篡改签名：预期 False

div.style: color: rgb(88, 28, 135) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
result4 = verify.verify(message, pk, sig, ctx=b'Test')
修改上下文：预期 False

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: print 四个验签结果

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: assert result1 is True

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: assert result2 is False

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: assert result3 is False

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: assert result4 is False

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: 抛出 AssertionError，程序终止

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: print：完整签名验签测试通过！

div.style: color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
实线只表示 main.py 的执行顺序
节点内部说明真实被调函数及其直接辅助调用
不表示前一个函数调用后一个函数
未捕获的运行异常会直接向外传播
